## Change

Describe the user-visible behavior and link the issue.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passed on the submitted revision.
- [ ] Behavior tests cover the change and relevant failure paths.
- [ ] UI changes were checked in light/dark and on mobile where applicable.

Record the checked commit SHA and any manual/browser evidence. Local validation is not a successful hosted CI status. Describe any unavailable checks.

## Release impact

State breaking changes, migration/storage implications and intended release impact where relevant. Short-lived feature/fix PRs target main. Versions and tags mark deliberate releases, not every feature merge.
